review: Independent documentation review: connected Macro Studio recording
correction_to_prior_source_review: The earlier source-review note incorrectly described ReleaseAll as globally scoped. The final docs correctly distinguish agent_runtime Request::ReleaseAll, which cancels/releases only that connected client, from local session Request::ReleaseAll, which remains session-wide.
verified_claims: Inspect is read-only and does not require the mutation grant; mutation commands require session-control and active permitted user.

Record Start requires an active allowed user, selected allowed target, idle lane and no held input for that user; holds on other users do not block it. Only the owning client can Stop, including after focus changes.

Recording covers only the owner client's successfully accepted logical actions, before output conversion; it excludes physical, manual, other-client and replicated inputs, and does not claim application consumption.

Batch preflight failures record no actions, but earlier successful batch members and partial text effects may remain delivered. Capacity is checked before emission; invalid/empty commit preserves the existing clip/revision.

The assessment scope is accurately bounded to six native groups, 14 named outcomes, 28 GUI receipts, three frames, two x64 targets and no i686 execution; the historical authoring/playback result remains separate.

The contract preserves pending-local editor fields when external ACK telemetry arrives, distinguishes working and committed clips, and states that discard does not undo already delivered target input.
Skill frontmatter and tool count remain consistent with the existing 23-tool surface; no new permission or tool is claimed.
limits: Documentation/source-scope review only; native acceptance is represented by the canonical assessment and no broader Ultra parity is claimed.
